ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try streaming alongside my DVD player, though my 720p TV would not benefit from 4K.

ItemID: NA; Title: Fire 7 tablet, 7" display, 16 GB, (2019 release), Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my tablet use, but I would pass this time because I already have a Fire 7 with the same storage capacity.
